name: paper-adventure
label: Бумажное приключение
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity RASTER ART-DIRECTED DESIGN PROPOSAL showing an ENTIRE desktop website homepage, top navigation through footer, as ONE very tall image, target 1280 x 3840 px, aspect ratio 1:3. This is a full-page desktop website screenshot with 2–3 column desktop sections, NOT a mobile screen, NOT a poster, NOT a moodboard, NOT a collage of multiple screenshots. All sections must be visible in order without cropping the bottom. No browser chrome, devices, presentation frame, designer annotations or English labels.
Project: Russian children's educational website about food called «Три друга на тарелке», ages 8–12. The previous layout was too boring and repetitive. Create a memorable, delightful, sophisticated children's editorial website, vibrant but calm enough to read. Every section must have a distinct composition, integrated illustration, clear navigable UI and consistent spacing. Avoid the generic SaaS pattern of identical rounded white cards on beige from top to bottom. Avoid making an all-over illustration with no usable hierarchy.
Reference image 1 = approved cut-paper world, material and atmosphere; images 2 and 3 = exact boy and girl identity, outfits, proportions. Image 4 = simple paper prop shapes and food. Preserve the references' characters: kind 10-year-old brown-haired boy, cream sun T-shirt, green shorts, cream sneakers; slightly taller 11-year-old girl, pale-pink bob, daisy clip, light-yellow dress, green sandals. European picture-book style, small simple eyes, not anime, not toddlers. Do not invent other principal characters. They can act, reach, carry, point, lean on the section edges, but retain their identity.
Material: matte FLAT pieces of colored cut paper, subtly irregular scissor edges, a FEW broad color shapes, quiet sparse fibers, short soft contact shadows directly beneath overlapping edges. Keep food equally simplified paper cutouts: flat apple shapes, cucumber slices, broad rice groups, toast, eggs, fish, beans. No realistic food photography, glossy 3D, clay, wet food surfaces, baked crust pores, all-over noise filters or embossed textures. The material may stay consistent while backgrounds, composition and palette change between sections. No need to copy the reference garden in every section.
CONTENT REQUIRED, identical information in all variants:
1 Header: small plate logo + «Три друга»; navigation «Смотреть», «Играть», «Семейное меню», «Взрослым».
2 Hero: main Russian heading exactly «Три друга на тарелке», small text «Истории и игры о еде · 8–12 лет», two obvious buttons «Смотреть мультфильм» and «Выбрать игру». Boy and girl doing something together around food or a paper plate, making the viewer curious. One short speech bubble «Тосту скучно одному!».
3 Compact introduction to the three food groups, titled «Кого позовём на тарелку?» and exactly three labels «Овощи и фрукты», «Крупы и хлеб», «Белок». Use real illustrated foods and an understandable plate diagram, not just icons. No calorie rules or rigid portion prescriptions.
4 Film block «Смотрим истории»: one prominent landscape video poster «Три друга на тарелке» with play button and «68 секунд», plus two smaller episode previews «Сад в животе» — «27 секунд» and «Ужин: слушай живот» — «26 секунд». All three previews and labels visible.
5 Games block «Пробуем сами» with SEVEN discoverable game entries, each clearly clickable with arrow or small «Играть» action, one recommended game emphasized. Exact titles: «Собери тарелку», «Паровозик и сад», «Ланч-бокс для друга», «Что в блюде?», «Правда или миф», «Что говорит живот?», «Собери перекус». Tiny helper text «Ошибаться можно — герои подскажут». Show illustrative previews of mechanics: plate with missing food, magnifying glass and garden, lunchbox, mixed dish, true/false cards, tummy signals, fruit and yogurt. Character art should not drown the labels.
6 Visibly calmer adult section «Продолжим дома» with title «Что приготовить завтра?», three attractive simple paper-food previews for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Recipe names «Сырники с ягодами», «Плов с курицей», «Рыба с картошкой». CTA «Все 45 блюд и заготовки».
7 Adult FAQ block «Родителям и учителям» with 3 tidy accordion rows: «Нужно ли доедать?», «Как говорить о еде?», «На что мы опираемся?», and small link «Источники». Footer brand and compact navigation.
Typography inspired by Balsamiq Sans for expressive titles and Nunito for readable body/UI. All text in Russian with clean readable Cyrillic. Use only short supporting copy, no long paragraphs or lorem ipsum. Do not include AI/tool mentions, fabricated ratings or medical claims. Deliver a richly illustrated full-page DESIGN IMAGE, not code.

ART DIRECTION: «Бумажное приключение». A continuous scrolling story-world with a winding paper path threading through distinct sections. Hero feels like a beautiful panoramic pop-up storybook landscape: large confident title on a pale sky/cream left zone, interacting boy and girl with a huge plate on the right, crisp silhouettes, oversized cut-paper leaves at edges. The three food groups become three parts of a gentle garden table scene with readable tags. Film section transforms into an intimate midnight-teal outdoor paper cinema, one big screen and two small ticket-like episode previews; enough contrast and a strong focal play button. Games section becomes a playful sunny exploration map of SEVEN distinct labeled activity stations connected by a restrained dotted route, balanced for easy scanning, not a required linear course. Adult menu becomes a warm peach kitchen tabletop with three actual dish previews and a wide green action. FAQ returns to quiet cream sheets; dark forest footer. Rhythm of open scenes and contained UI. Colors: sky blue, pale butter, fern green, terracotta; dusk teal at cinema. A memorable crafted world with clear readable web layout; no generic dashboard card grid. Preserve the approved characters and flat-paper material. ENTIRE PAGE must be present.
